the CFC specs.  Each section links to the canonical spec location, states current
branch compliance candidly, and provides an org-babel-friendly shell placeholder.

Status legend:

- ~implemented~: there is a direct runnable demo that substantially matches the
  scenario semantics.
- ~partial~: we have meaningful substrate coverage or a related live demo, but not
  full spec-faithful behavior.
- ~missing~: no real implementation yet; placeholder/demo should illustrate the gap.
